The first idea that popped up in his mind was to create equipment that could defend against missiles. Han Xiao happened to know of a basic level purely defensive mechanical blueprint that was suitable for him. It was called the Deployable Mini Explosion-Proof Fortress. It would instantly form a metal cover to protect the target and resist the explosion and shockwaves.

There were many kinds of defensive blueprints, the most well-known of which were the various kinds of energy shields. However, that required advanced energy knowledge, and the technical requirements for this small explosion-proof fortress were not that high. The blueprints could be fused with basic knowledge, and the defensive performance depended on the materials used.

However, Han Xiao quickly rejected the idea of making one himself. He did not have a lathe when he was on the run, so he would not be able to complete any complicated manufacturing work. At most, he would modify the vehicles and weapons, dismantle the enemy's equipment, and make some simple things that he was familiar with. However, making a small explosion-proof fortress would be too much work.

After eliminating this method, Han Xiao had a new idea.

"Missile defense … It still needs to be done by professionals."

…

As soon as he escaped from the headquarters, the Germinal Organization immediately mobilized. Under the orders of the leader, countless Germinal Organization troops conducted a carpet search in the area of influence. Both the flying and ground forces were mobilized at the same time. The scale of the search was almost the same as a direct battle.

An hour later, the Six Nations discovered the Germinal Organization's movements. Since they did not know the details, they could only respond by increasing their vigilance to prevent the Germinal Organization from having other strategic objectives. That night, they held an emergency joint analysis meeting to deduce the Germinal Organization's intentions.

The commanders of the various countries discussed intensely for more than half an hour. Through various signs, they finally came to an unbelievable conclusion.

The Germinal Organization was chasing after someone!

That was strange. The Six Nations had already attacked the Germinal Organization's base camp, and the Germinal Organization still had the time to chase after someone else. The identity of the person being chased must be very special. Love ↑ go △ little ↑ say △ netw

We have received important information. The target has contacted our intelligence agency. Please allow me to transfer his communication to the main channel."

They recognized that he was Zero, who was wanted by the Germinal Organization. The person who had been providing them with intelligence had finally appeared. Everyone was shocked.

"You're the one that the Germinal Organization is after?!"

"Why are you in the Germinal Organization's territory?"

Han Xiao said, "I infiltrated the Germinal Organization headquarters and obtained key information from the mainframe. All their deployments, plans, and missile deployment details are in my hands. That's why the Germinal Organization is chasing after me at all costs. Now, I want to make a deal with you."

Everyone looked at each other. No one had asked Zero to steal information, but he had taken the initiative to do so. How much hatred did he have for the Germinal Organization? He wanted to win the war more than they did.

Han Xiao was prepared to use the information from the Germinal Organization headquarters as a bargaining chip in exchange for the cooperation of the Six Nations. This information was originally meant for the Six Nations, but now it was being used to its fullest potential.

At the beginning, Han Xiao's plan was to sneak into the headquarters and complete everything. However, Destiny's Child's prediction had led the leader to set up an ambush long ago, which deviated from his original plan. Han Xiao had no choice but to change his plan.

The appearance of Destiny's Child was unexpected, but he was not depressed. Everything could not be smooth sailing. He was not afraid of accidents. He just had to adapt to the situation.

An officer said coldly, "Empty words have no basis. Hand over all the information, and we will consider your terms."
